26▪Refinery performance declined as fluctuations in feedstock prices and market spreads, while crude oil prices 
were influenced by easing U.S. trade concerns and OPEC’s decision to unwind its production cuts. 
Meanwhile, key refined product spreads improved, driven by pre -Fall inventory buildup and lower export 
quotas from China.
▪Stable BTX P2F, mainly due to an increase in PX spread, resulting from higher PX price from supply control 
and incoming seasonal demand from PTA producers. This was offset by decreasing BZ spread from excess 
capacity and weak downstream demand from US tariffs, along with the fluctuation in feedstock costs.
▪Naphtha feedstock prices increased following the drone attack in Russia which disrupted naphtha supply. 
▪Ethelyne and Propylene price down resulted from an excess supply in SEA.
